title: Decompose Conditional

solutions.title: One name each for the question and the two answers
solutions.tradeoff: Three small functions replace one compact if/else, so a reader who wants the whole rule at a glance now reads three names and trusts them instead of scanning six lines - worth it here because the six lines were never actually readable to begin with.

reviewFocus: Does isOutOfHours read as a question you could answer yes or no to, without opening it?
Were both branches extracted, or only the more interesting one - and if only one, is the other genuinely too small to earn a name?
Do the two charge functions still share the CLINIC_OPENS_MINUTE / CLINIC_CLOSES_MINUTE constants, or did a magic number creep back in during extraction?
Is Math.round applied exactly once, on the result, rather than inside each branch?
Would a reviewer who has never seen this file understand what out-of-hours means for Fernbank Clinic from the names alone, without reading a single body?
